action.title: Identifies if a record is to be upserted (inserted or updated) or (hard) deleted.

id.description: The ID of the Account object.

key.title: Stores data about account objects in the Canvas system.
key.description: Accounts are most often used to represent a hierarchy of colleges, schools, departments, campuses.

name.description: The display name of the account.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp of when the account was deleted. Will only ever be NULL for end customers.

parent_account_id.description: The account's parent ID, or NULL if this is the root account.

current_sis_batch_id.description: The ID of the currently processing SIS (Student Information System) batch (if submitted via UI, not API).

storage_quota.description: The storage quote for the account, in megabytes.

default_storage_quota.description: The storage quota for children accounts in megabytes, if not otherwise specified.

default_user_storage_quota.description: The default storage quota for users in the account in megabytes, if not otherwise specified.

default_group_storage_quota.description: The storage quota for a group in the account in megabytes, if not otherwise specified.

integration_id.description: The account's identifier in the Student Information System.

lti_context_id.description: UUID of the Canvas context in LTI standard. Secondary ID for this context, could be used in API to identify resource as well.

consortium_parent_account_id.description: The root account of the consortium account, if this root account is part of a consortium.

course_template_id.description: The course selected as a template for new courses created in this account. 0 if a template should not be used, nor inherited.

created_at.description: Timestamp of when the account was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of when the account was updated.

default_time_zone.description: The default time zone of the account. Allowed time zones are [IANA time zones](https://www.iana.org/time-zones) or friendlier [Ruby on Rails time zones](https://api.rubyonrails.org/classes/ActiveSupport/TimeZone.html).

sis_source_id.description: Correlated id for the record for this course in the SIS system (assuming SIS integration is configured)

value.title: Stores data about account objects in the Canvas system.
value.description: Accounts are most often used to represent a hierarchy of colleges, schools, departments, campuses.
